messages:
Sam (AE): Incoming RFP from OrionLedger — they want a short POC plan, capability matrix, and answers to an encryption/HSM section. Need a draft in 24h.
Ivy (SE): Quick take: HSM support varies by deployment. Hosted = cloud KMS only; Dedicated can integrate provider-backed HSMs; Private supports BYO-HSM but requires cert checks.
Hector (Infra): Timing: Hosted PoC (no HSM) = 1 business day. Dedicated reserved pool = ~3 business days. Private BYO-HSM onboarding = ~10 business days (cert validation + ops). If customer enforces no external egress, air-gapped deploy adds 2-3 weeks.
Rina (Product): For throughput, recommend we state assumptions: model size, 8k context, concurrency. Proposed wording: "Embeddings (8k ctx): Hosted 65-130 rps; Dedicated 380-680 rps; Private depends on GPU count (estimate 500 rps per A100-equivalent)."
Tess (Legal): BYO-HSM okay for Private with addendum. Need SOC2, HSM vendor attestations, explicit data residency clause. I'll prepare clause and checklist.
Sam (AE): Can someone paste a compact CSV-style matrix I can paste into their RFP?
Ivy (SE): CSV snippet:```feature,hosted,dedicated,private
SLA,usage-tier,99.9% reserved,99.95% private
HSM,cloud KMS only,optional provider HSM,BYO-HSM (cert req)
Throughput (embeddings,8k),65-130 rps,380-680 rps,custom (gpu dependent)
Region controls,limited,regional,customer-controlled
Audit logs,standard,extended,full export
Network,egress via NAT,peered VPCs,customer network only
Rollouts,model pinning,canary + A/B,canary + manual fallback
```
Hector (Infra): Add note: Dedicated trial available for 7 days on minimal commit. Private BYO-HSM needs certs + test access.
Sam (AE): Great — I'll assemble the reply with 3 options (fast hosted, reserved dedicated, secure private) and include timelines & caveats. Ping me when drive doc updated.
Ivy (SE): Done. Pushed matrix and a short POC runbook to the shared drive link.
TicketBot: Created ticket INF-8362 for OrionLedger private onboarding.
Sam (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll send draft to procurement tomorrow morning and loop Legal for the addendum.
